customfield_10838.name: Steps to Reproduce
customfield_10838.note: Jira metadata reports this as a plain textarea string, but create/edit actually rejects a string and requires ADF doc content. Use an orderedList — one listItem per step; steps with a visible result use a bold 'Expected:' lead-in; route/URL/query fragments use inline code marks.

constraints.note: Not surfaced by getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields — only appears as a create-time error: 'Must be linked to an Epic using the Parent field'. Infer a plausible parent Epic from recent sibling tickets in the same project/issue type before asking the user.
